<b>Phacias</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are white drifting bugs that disguise themselves as flowers and disperse pollen clouds.<ref>Phacia [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Drifting bug disguised as a flower. Disperses crackling clouds of pollen if threatened."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Phacias float in place and slowly return to their original position if they are pushed away from it. They are drawn towards [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s [[Challenge]] ability or any shakes from Hornet colliding with surfaces.

When Hornet is in range, they screech and indicate the area of effect before releasing a large cloud of harmful pollen that combos Hornet for {{Damage|1+1}}.

They may sometimes be found disguised as flowers, only revealing themselves when Hornet approaches.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-threaded]] Phacias have their health doubled. They gain the [[Black-Threading#Movesets|Void Blades]] attack, which replaces their normal pollen cloud.

Phacias can be found in [[Shellwood]], the [[Memorium]], and the [[Grand Gate]].
